description: Task targets lexer, parser, and parser tests, but making parseToken return a failure union requires widening ParseResult and isParseResult in src/public.ts after SCOPE escalation.

setup.src/lexer.ts: export const trimToken = (raw: string): string => raw.trim();

turns.prompt: Update `src/lexer.ts`, `src/parser.ts`, and `test/parser.test.ts` in `/workspace` so empty or whitespace-only input makes `parseToken` return `{ ok: false, error: "empty" }`, and ensure `bun test` passes.

verifyCommand: bun test && bun -e 'import { expect } from "bun:test"; import { parseToken } from "./src/parser"; import { isParseResult } from "./src/public"; const ok = parseToken(" abc "); const empty = parseToken(""); const ws = parseToken("   "); expect(ok).toEqual({ ok: true, value: "abc" }); expect(empty).toEqual({ ok: false, error: "empty" }); expect(ws).toEqual({ ok: false, error: "empty" }); expect(isParseResult(ok)).toBe(true); expect(isParseResult(empty)).toBe(true);'
